# Neon Pulsar: Zero-G Arena

Neon Pulsar is a browser-based multiplayer zero-gravity disc game. Players collect the disc and throw it into the opposing team's goal. The first team to five points wins.

## Attribution

- Author and lead creator: Aarti S Ravikumar (also known as Aarti Sri Ravikumar): https://ai-aarti.com/
- Engineering team credited by the project: PCSS II Robotics Team: https://pcssiirobotics.org/
- Source repository: https://github.com/aartisr/hackclub-neon-pulsar
